title: Document Lens
description: A local-first desktop instrument for lens-based analysis of document corpora. A lens is researcher-supplied data: analysis axes, a polarised keyword list, and a scoring-rule binding. The application exposes coverage heatmaps, axis cross-tabulations, a configurable document score, longitudinal trends, cross-document comparison, contextual auditing, and a concordance reader that links every match back to the source page. Documents, extracted text, and computed signals stay in a local SQLite database; optional machine-learning features are local and non-fatal. The first lens is sustainability reporting, with an 'Other' section for researcher-defined lenses. Open source under the MIT licence.
